dialogue.origin: (本日14:00~よろしくお願いします。クライエント役の「こと」です)
dialogue.content: (Hello. Our session is scheduled for 2:00 PM today. I'm "Koto," playing the client role.)

dialogue.origin: よろしくおねがいします。
dialogue.content: It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.origin: お時間早いですが準備がよろしければ始めたいのですがよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: We're a little early, but if you're ready, I'd like to begin. Is that alright with you?

dialogue.origin: (大丈夫ですよ。始まる前にお名前うかがっても良いですか？こちらに名前が出ないのでカルテを書く時に必要でして)
dialogue.content: (That's fine. Before we begin, may I ask your name? It doesn't display on my end, and I need it for the chart.)

dialogue.origin: （すいません。みたらし団子です。よろしくおねがいいたします）
dialogue.content: (My apologies. I'm Mitarashi Dango. Nice to meet you.)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です
dialogue.content: Hello. I'm your counselor.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: 本日はご相談いただきありがとうございます。本日はどのようなごそうだんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for reaching out today. What would you like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 夫のことで悩んでいます。
dialogue.content: I'm having some trouble with my husband.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。夫さんのどのようなことでお悩みか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Could you tell me more about what specifically is troubling you about your husband?

dialogue.origin: 夫がすごく怒りっぽくて…そんなことで怒るの！？ということでずっと怒っているんです…
dialogue.content: He gets angry very easily... He's always angry about things that make me think, "You're getting angry over that?!"

dialogue.origin: それは困りますね，，，
dialogue.content: That must be difficult...

dialogue.origin: どのようなときに夫さんは怒るのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: In what kinds of situations does your husband get angry?

dialogue.origin: 私からしたら本当にささいなことなんです、、、
dialogue.content: From my perspective, they're really trivial things...

dialogue.origin: 例えば、、、
dialogue.content: For example...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: この前は、娘と私が夫とは買い物をしていて待ち合わせの時間に来なくて30分待っても来ないし、電話もつながらないので
dialogue.content: The other day, my daughter and I were out shopping and were supposed to meet my husband. He didn't show up at the meeting time, and even after waiting 30 minutes, he still wasn't there, and he wasn't answering his phone.

dialogue.origin: LINEして先に家に帰るねって帰ったんです
dialogue.content: So I sent him a LINE message saying we were going home ahead of him, and we left.

dialogue.origin: そしたら、
dialogue.content: And then—

dialogue.origin: 1カ月口をきいてくれませんでした
dialogue.content: he didn't speak to me for a month.

dialogue.origin: 他にも…
dialogue.content: There are other things, too...

dialogue.origin: ご飯がおいしくないと食べないで、別のものを作って一人で食べたり
dialogue.content: If he doesn't like the dinner I've made, he won't eat it and will make something else to eat by himself.

dialogue.origin: そんなに口をきいてくれないなんて．．．悲しいですね
dialogue.content: For him not to speak to you for that long... that must be very sad.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 他にもなにかありますか？お話遮ってしまいましたね。すいません
dialogue.content: Is there anything else? I'm sorry, I interrupted you.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ…他にもあって、、、
dialogue.content: No, no... There are other things...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: 1月に夫の誕生日の時にサプライズでプレゼントを用意したら「好みじゃないしお金がもったいないから返してこい！」って言われて…
dialogue.content: In January, for my husband's birthday, I prepared a surprise gift, and he said, "This isn't my taste, and it's a waste of money, so go return it!"

dialogue.origin: 「なんでこんなに一緒にいるのに好みも分からないんだ」って
dialogue.content: He said, "How can you not know my preferences after we've been together for so long?"

dialogue.origin: 3日間口をきいてくれませんでした
dialogue.content: He didn't speak to me for three days.

dialogue.origin: 何で怒るか分からなくて・・・
dialogue.content: I just don't understand what sets him off...

dialogue.origin: そんなことを言われてしまったんですね...サプライズで喜んでくれると思ったのに、それはさみしいですね
dialogue.content: He said that to you... You thought he would be happy with the surprise, so that must have been very disheartening.

dialogue.origin: はい...ビックリして言葉も出なかったです…
dialogue.content: Yes... I was so shocked I was at a loss for words.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんは怒ると口をきいてくれなくなるようですが、いつもこんな感じなんですか？
dialogue.content: It seems your husband gives you the silent treatment when he's angry. Is he always like this?

dialogue.origin: 機嫌がいいときはふつうに会話をしてくれるんですけど、怒りのスイッチが入るといつそれがおさまるか分からないんです。
dialogue.content: When he's in a good mood, we can talk normally, but once his anger switch flips, I don't know when it will settle down.

dialogue.origin: 1カ月口をきかないこともあれば、すぐに機嫌が直るときもあります
dialogue.content: Sometimes he won't speak for a month; other times he gets over it quickly.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね...日によって違うと対応も大変ですね
dialogue.content: I see... When it varies by the day, it makes it hard to know how to respond.

dialogue.origin: はい、すごく疲れます…
dialogue.content: Yes, it's very exhausting.

dialogue.origin: とても気をつかってすごされていますよね
dialogue.content: You must be walking on eggshells all the time.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。。。いつも夫の顔色をうかがっていますね
dialogue.content: Yes... I'm always trying to read his mood.

dialogue.origin: お話の途中ですが、本日なんとお呼びしたらよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: Pardon the interruption, but how should I address you today?

dialogue.origin: 「こと」でお願いします
dialogue.content: Please call me "Koto."

dialogue.origin: わかりました。
dialogue.content: Understood.

dialogue.origin: ことさんは夫さんが怒り出したらどのように対応されるのですか？
dialogue.content: Koto, how do you respond when your husband starts getting angry?

dialogue.origin: 最初は謝るんですけど、とにかく無視なんです
dialogue.content: I apologize at first, but he just ignores me completely.

dialogue.origin: 私があいさつをしても、質問をしても無視されます
dialogue.content: Even if I greet him or ask a question, he ignores me.

dialogue.origin: でもいつ機嫌が直るか分からないので
dialogue.content: But I never know when his mood will improve, so...

dialogue.origin: それはひどいですね．．．謝っているというのに無視なんて...
dialogue.content: That's terrible... Ignoring you even when you're apologizing...

dialogue.origin: それまであいさつとか質問はします
dialogue.content: Until then, I still greet him and ask him questions.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですかね、ひどいんですかね
dialogue.content: I wonder... is that really terrible?

dialogue.origin: これが当たり前でマヒしてきています
dialogue.content: It's become so normal that I've grown numb to it.

dialogue.origin: 私が怒らせちゃったのが悪いのかなって
dialogue.content: I start to think maybe it's my fault for making him angry.

dialogue.origin: マヒしてしまうくらい怒ることに慣れてしまって...私はひどいとおもいました
dialogue.content: You've become so used to his anger that you're numb to it... I do think it's a terrible situation.

dialogue.origin: ことさんが夫さんのこと怒らせてしまっていると思っているのですね
dialogue.content: You feel as though you're the one making him angry.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、、、言われるとひどいような気もしますけど、ずっとこうだから…
dialogue.content: Yes... Now that you say it, it does feel terrible, but it's been like this for so long...

dialogue.origin: 怒らせているようなこと心辺りはあるのですか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any idea what might be causing his anger?

dialogue.origin: うーん、、、ご飯が口に合わないとか、プレゼントが気に入らないとか…
dialogue.content: Well... the food not being to his liking, or him not liking a present...

dialogue.origin: なんでこんなに怒るのか私も分からないんですけど
dialogue.content: But I don't understand why he gets so angry about these things.

dialogue.origin: 怒らせようと思って行動してないのに怒るので
dialogue.content: I'm not trying to make him angry, but he gets angry anyway.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね...喜ばれると思ってやったことが気に入らないことが多いですよね、、、、
dialogue.content: I understand... It seems that things you do thinking they will please him often have the opposite effect...

dialogue.origin: 無念というか...どうしていいかわからなくなってしまいますね
dialogue.content: It's frustrating... It must make you feel at a loss for what to do.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、これからどうやって生活していけばいいんだろうって思いますね
dialogue.content: Yes, it makes me wonder how I'm supposed to go on living like this.

dialogue.origin: 毎日生活しているわけですからいろいろと考えてしまいますね
dialogue.content: Since you're living together every day, it must weigh on your mind a lot.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、機嫌がいいときはいいけど、無視の日が続くと堪えますね・・・
dialogue.content: Yes, it's fine when he's in a good mood, but when the silent treatment goes on for days, it really takes a toll...

dialogue.origin: 娘さんに対しては夫さんは怒るのですか？
dialogue.content: Does your husband get angry with your daughter?

dialogue.origin: 娘には怒らなくて、娘を通して会話をしたりします
dialogue.content: He doesn't get angry with our daughter, and sometimes he talks to me through her.

dialogue.origin: 娘には優しいです
dialogue.content: He's kind to her.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。娘さんんいは特にないんですね。それも複雑な心境になりますね
dialogue.content: I see. So he doesn't do it to your daughter. That must create some complex feelings for you.

dialogue.origin: はい、けど娘には怒らないので少し安心です
dialogue.content: Yes, but I'm a little relieved that he doesn't get angry at her.

dialogue.origin: 家族みんなに怒っているわけではないので、よかったです
dialogue.content: It's good that he isn't angry with everyone in the family.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、私にだけですね
dialogue.content: That's right, it's only me.

dialogue.origin: 娘に怒らないのは少し救いですね
dialogue.content: It's a small relief that he doesn't get angry with our daughter.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんは怒るときは口だけですか？それともなにか行動されることもありますか？
dialogue.content: When he gets angry, is it only verbal, or does he take any actions as well?

dialogue.origin: 1度家を出てったこともありますが、基本は、言葉と無視ですね
dialogue.content: He left the house once, but basically, it's harsh words and ignoring me.

dialogue.origin: 暴力とかはないです
dialogue.content: There's no physical violence.

dialogue.origin: それは安心いたしました。しかし、一緒に生活されてるのに無視というのはおつらいですよね
dialogue.content: That's a relief to hear. However, being ignored by someone you live with must be very painful.

dialogue.origin: ことさんは夫さんとこのことについてはお話されたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Koto, have you ever spoken with your husband about this issue?

dialogue.origin: お話というのは、夫本人にですか？
dialogue.content: Spoken about it... you mean with my husband himself?

dialogue.origin: はい。夫さんに直接お話したことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Yes. Have you ever spoken to him about it directly?

dialogue.origin: はい。なんでそんなことで怒るの？とか、無視は悲しいよとか言うんですけど…
dialogue.content: Yes. I've said things like, "Why do you get so angry over something like that?" or "It makes me sad when you ignore me," but...

dialogue.origin: お前が悪い、とか100倍にして返っきて疲れるので言うのはやめました
dialogue.content: He just says, "It's your fault," or retorts with something 100 times worse, and it's exhausting, so I stopped bringing it up.

dialogue.origin: 夫は言葉が強くて達者なんです
dialogue.content: My husband is very harsh and sharp with his words.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。お伝えするとことさんご自身が余計しんどくなってしまいますね．．．
dialogue.content: I see. So when you try to tell him how you feel, it ends up being even more difficult for you...

dialogue.origin: そうなんです、自分に返ってきて余計つかれます
dialogue.content: Exactly; it rebounds on me and leaves me even more drained.

dialogue.origin: 娘さんとは夫さんのことお話されたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you ever talked with your daughter about your husband?

dialogue.origin: 娘はまだ4才なので...「ママとパパけんかしてるの？」って聞かれたりしましたけど、最近は空気を呼んでか聞かなくなりました...
dialogue.content: My daughter is only 4 years old... She used to ask, "Are Mommy and Daddy fighting?" but recently, maybe because she's reading the room, she's stopped asking...

dialogue.origin: 娘さんも心配されるくらいなんですね。お優しい娘さんですね
dialogue.content: So it's enough to make your daughter worry. She sounds like a very sweet girl.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、4才なのに空気をよませてしまって申し訳ない気持ちもあります
dialogue.content: Yes, I feel guilty for making a 4-year-old feel like she has to read the room.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね．．．悲しくなりますね。すこしお話まとめてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I can imagine... That's very sad. Would it be alright if I summarized what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.origin: はい、お願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんが怒りっぽいことで悩んでいらっしゃいます。
dialogue.content: You're struggling with your husband's tendency to get angry easily.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ことさんからするとささいなことで怒っていて、どうしてそんなことで怒るのかわからないことが多いです
dialogue.content: From your perspective, he gets angry over trivial matters, and often you don't understand why.

dialogue.origin: お買い物をして待ち合わせしても来ないので、先にかえっていたら怒っていたり、
dialogue.content: For instance, he got angry when you went home ahead of him after he didn't show up at your meeting spot while shopping,

dialogue.origin: ご飯も口に合わないと食べずにつくって食べていたり
dialogue.content: If the meal isn't to his taste, he doesn't eat it and cooks something else for himself.

dialogue.origin: サプライズでプレゼントしたりすると好みが違うといって怒られてしまい、そして口をきいてもらえないことが多々あります
dialogue.content: and he gets angry when you give him a surprise gift, saying it's not his style. These incidents often lead to him giving you the silent treatment.

dialogue.origin: 娘さんとは普通に接してくれているので安心です。
dialogue.content: You're relieved that he interacts normally with your daughter.

dialogue.origin: ことさんだけに怒っているだけですが、娘さんにも心配させてしまっています
dialogue.content: While his anger is directed only at you, it still worries your daughter.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんが怒っていることをお話されると、ことさんが悪いといわれ、100倍になって返ってくるので、疲れてしまうので言わなくなりました。
dialogue.content: When you've tried to talk to him about his anger, he says it's your fault and retorts with something much worse, so you've stopped bringing it up because it's too exhausting.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんがなんで怒るのかよくわからずとてもお困りでいらっしゃいます
dialogue.content: You're very troubled because you don't understand why your husband gets angry.

dialogue.origin: こんな感じでよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is that a fair summary?

dialogue.origin: はい、こんな感じです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's about right.

dialogue.origin: いつも怒っていらっしゃるので疲れてしまいますよね。そしてこの先どのようにしていいのかわからないですよね。とても難しい問題ですので一緒に考えていけたらと思っています
dialogue.content: Feeling he's always angry must be exhausting, and it leaves you unsure how to move forward. It's a very difficult situation, so I'd like us to think it through together.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうざいます。そうですね、いつ地雷をふむかびくびくしています
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you. I'm constantly on edge, worried about when I might step on a landmine.

dialogue.origin: 確かに怖いですよね...
dialogue.content: That is understandably frightening...

dialogue.origin: ことさんは日中は娘さんの面倒をみられていらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.content: Koto, do you look after your daughter during the day?

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 娘のことは保育園に預けています
dialogue.content: My daughter is in daycare.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。日中はお仕事をされて、帰ってきてからは家事と育児をこなされていてとても大変でいらしゃいますね
dialogue.content: I see. So you work during the day, and when you get home, you handle the housework and childcare. That must be very demanding.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、仕事も育児も疲れますね。でも私がやらないとなので
dialogue.content: Yes, both work and childcare are tiring. But I feel like I have to do it.

dialogue.origin: とても頑張っていらっしゃるのですねことさんは夫さんの何が一番お困りですか？今はすぐに怒ることでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You're working very hard. What troubles you most about your husband? Is it how quickly he gets angry?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、、、何で怒るか分からないことと、夫が今仕事をしてないので未来の不安もありますね
dialogue.content: Yes... Not knowing what triggers his anger, and also the fact that he's not working now—I'm anxious about the future.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。夫さんはお仕事されていないんですね。それはとても心配になりますよね
dialogue.content: I see. So your husband isn't working at the moment. That's understandably very concerning.

dialogue.origin: はい、、、自分が働かなきゃって思います
dialogue.content: Yes... I feel I have to be the one to work.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。自分がって思ってしまいますよね夫さんは昼間は何をされてお過ごしなんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: That makes sense—you feel it's on you. How does your husband spend his days?

dialogue.origin: ずっと家にいます。私の掃除の仕方が気に入らないようなので、掃除とかはしてくれますけど。ゴロゴロしてるんじゃないですかねぇ…
dialogue.content: He's always at home. He does do some cleaning, since he doesn't seem to like the way I do it. But I think he mostly just lazes around...

dialogue.origin: お掃除してくれているんですね。助かりますね。ですが、ちょっと心配にはなりますね。
dialogue.content: So he does the cleaning. That's helpful. But it is a little concerning.

dialogue.origin: ことさんはお仕事終わって夫さんに日中何をしていたかきくことはあるのですか？
dialogue.content: After you finish work, do you ever ask your husband what he did during the day?

dialogue.origin: 機嫌がよさそうな日は聞きますね。「何してたの？」と聞くと、音楽聞いてたとか、本読んでたとかそんな感じですね
dialogue.content: I ask on days when he seems to be in a good mood. When I ask, "What were you up to?" he says things like listening to music or reading a book.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。夫さんはお仕事どうされたいと思っていらしゃるのでしょうか？以前とかお仕事されていたこととかるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. What does he want to do about work? Has he worked previously?

dialogue.origin: 夫はフリーランスなんですけど、今は仕事がなくて…半年前までは働いていて、それまでとても忙しかったので今は人生の休暇中というか、
dialogue.content: He's a freelancer, but he doesn't have work right now... He was working until six months ago and was very busy until then, so it's like he's on a life hiatus now,

dialogue.origin: 私が働けばいいかと思っているんですけど、そろそろ働いてほしいなとは思っています。
dialogue.content: and he seems to think it's fine if I work, but I would like him to start working again soon.

dialogue.origin: 以前は忙しく働いていらっしゃたんですね。それは頼もしいですね。お忙しいこともあっておやすみしていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: So he used to be very busy with work. That's reassuring to know. He's taking a break because he was so busy.

dialogue.origin: ことさんからはお仕事のこと話されたりはしないのですか？
dialogue.content: Do you bring up the topic of work with him?

dialogue.origin: 仕事のことも聞くと機嫌が悪くなるので...「ちゃんと考えているから！」って。
dialogue.content: He gets into a bad mood if I ask about work... He says, "I'm thinking about it, okay!"

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか....それだと話しかけづらいですね
dialogue.content: I see... That makes it difficult to bring up.

dialogue.origin: ほんとです、、、家の中でも気を遣って疲れます
dialogue.content: It really does... I have to walk on eggshells even at home, and it's draining.

dialogue.origin: ことさんは今はお仕事してほしいと思っていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: Do you want him to find a job now?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、娘にもお金がかかりますし、働いてほしいけど、仕事のこと話すと怒ったりするので
dialogue.content: Yes, raising our daughter costs money, and I want him to work, but he gets angry if I talk about it.

dialogue.origin: 怒るから仕事のことにはなかなかふれられないですよね
dialogue.content: Because he gets angry, it's hard to touch on the topic of work.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんは日中おでかけとかされますか？
dialogue.content: Does your husband go out during the day?

dialogue.origin: 私は仕事でいないのでよく分からないんですけど、車でドライブしたりしているみたいですね。
dialogue.content: I'm not home because of work, so I'm not sure, but it seems he goes for drives in the car.

dialogue.origin: 機嫌がいい時にはそんな話をしたりします
dialogue.content: He'll mention things like that when he's in a good mood.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。お仕事を探しているかんじではないんですかね？
dialogue.content: I see. So it doesn't seem like he's actively looking for work?

dialogue.origin: はい、、、相手から声がかかって仕事をしていたので自分から行くのはプライドが許さないと思います
dialogue.content: Right... He used to get work through offers from clients, so I think his pride won't let him go out and look for it himself.

dialogue.origin: （みたらし団子さんがよろしければ10分延長しましょうか？お任せします）
dialogue.content: (If it's okay with you, Mitarashi Dango, shall we extend by 10 minutes? It's up to you.)

dialogue.origin: （おねがいします）
dialogue.content: (Yes, please.)

dialogue.origin: 夫さんにもいろいろとご事情があるかんじなんですね
dialogue.content: It sounds like your husband has his own circumstances and reasons.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、気難しい人なので、、、
dialogue.content: Yes, he's a difficult person...

dialogue.origin: ことさんはお仕事をされながら育児、家事をされていて大変な日々をお過ごしですね。そして今は夫さんがお仕事を休んでいることもあり、一人で夫さんの分も頑張っていらっしゃいますね
dialogue.content: Koto, you're managing work, childcare, and housework, which must be very difficult. And now with your husband on a break from work, you're shouldering his share of the burden as well.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、やるしかないって感じです
dialogue.content: Yes, it feels like I have no choice but to keep going.

dialogue.origin: 私が育休のときは夫が頑張って働いてくれたので
dialogue.content: When I was on maternity leave, my husband worked hard for us.

dialogue.origin: 急に怒ったり、無視をしたりする夫さんに対して、ことさんは夫さんのためにプレゼントしたりといろいろとされていて本当にお優しい方だと思います
dialogue.content: Despite your husband getting angry suddenly and ignoring you, you still do things for him like buying him presents. I think you are a very kind person.

dialogue.origin: 優しいというか、今日お話をしていてちょっとマヒしてたのかなって思いました
dialogue.content: Kind, or maybe... after talking today, I think I was just a bit numb to it all.

dialogue.origin: 提案とまではいきませんが、私の考えをすこしお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: This isn't exactly a suggestion, but would it be alright if I shared a thought with you?

dialogue.origin: はい、お願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: 一人で頑張っていらっしゃることとてもすごいと思います。
dialogue.content: I think it's remarkable how you're carrying so much on your own.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんがことさんが育休の間頑張っていたことや半年前頑張っていたと思うと確かにことさんご自身が頑張らなければと思ってしまうかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: Considering how he worked hard during your maternity leave and until six months ago, you might feel you have to step up now.

dialogue.origin: 夫さん、きっとお仕事がなかなか決まらなくてすこしいらだっているのかもしれないですよね。お仕事のお話されると怒るとおっしゃっていたので。
dialogue.content: He may be feeling frustrated that work isn't lining up easily. You mentioned he gets angry when the topic of work comes up.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、夫も言葉にできない思いがあるのかもしれないですね
dialogue.content: Yes, he may have feelings he can't put into words.

dialogue.origin: 将来の不安もすこしあるとことさんがおっしゃていたのですが、
dialogue.content: You mentioned you also have some anxiety about the future,

dialogue.origin: ことさんがお話すると怒るということでしたので、二つほどお話しますね
dialogue.content: and since he gets angry when you talk to him, I have a couple of ideas.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 娘さんに「パパお仕事いかないの？」とさりげなくきいてもらう。でも、娘さんはまだ小さいのでさりげなくはきびいしいですよね
dialogue.content: You could have your daughter casually ask him, "Daddy, aren't you going to work?" But, she's still little, so being subtle might be difficult.

dialogue.origin: もうひとつ、夫さんのご両親などにそれとなく後押ししてもらう。
dialogue.content: Another idea is to have his parents subtly give him a nudge.

dialogue.origin: なるほどー！夫の両親は割と疎遠なので、娘に女優になれる！？素質があるのか試してみようかな...。夫も娘には甘いですし
dialogue.content: I see! We're rather distant from his parents, so maybe I'll see if my daughter has the makings of an actress... My husband is soft on her, after all.

dialogue.origin: そのようなことを私自身が考えてみました。他にもなにかできるようなことがあればいいのですが...今は夫さんがお仕事されると不安も軽くなり怒るのも少なくなるのではないかとおもいました。
dialogue.content: These are just some things I thought of. I wish there was more that could be done... For now, I thought that if your husband were to start working, your anxiety would lessen and his anger might decrease as well.

dialogue.origin: 娘も「パパ仕事行かないのかな？」と私には聞いてくるんです。
dialogue.content: My daughter asks me, "I wonder if Daddy is going to work?"

dialogue.origin: いろいろとありがとうございます。そうですね
dialogue.content: Thank you for all your thoughts. Yes.

dialogue.origin: 夫にもいろんな気持ちがあってその気持ちが怒りや無視という
dialogue.content: He likely has many feelings, and those feelings may be showing up as anger or the silent treatment—

dialogue.origin: 行動に出ているのかもしれないですし
dialogue.content: That might be how he's acting them out.

dialogue.origin: 娘さんに手をかりられそうなら声かけてもらえたらいいですね
dialogue.content: If it seems you can enlist your daughter's help, it might be good to have her say something.

dialogue.origin: すこしでもことさんが幸せに暮らせるように祈っております
dialogue.content: I hope that you can live a little more happily.

dialogue.origin: ですね、娘に「ママに力を貸して！」と言えばやってくれそうな気がします。
dialogue.content: Yes, I feel like if I say to her, "Help Mommy out," she would do it.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 本日はご相談していただきありがとうがおざいます。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much for consulting with me today.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: 無理なさらずご家族がすごせることを願っております。ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Please don't overexert yourself; I hope your family can live without too much strain. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: （長くなってしまいましたが、ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (This ran a bit long, but thank you very much.)

dialogue.origin: （いえいえ、最後までいけましたね！おつかれさまです。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (Not at all, we made it to the end! Great work. Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: （とても勉強になりました。それでは失礼いたします）
dialogue.content: (This was very educational. I'll sign off now.)

dialogue.origin: （こちらこそ勉強になりました。失礼します）
dialogue.content: (It was educational for me as well. Goodbye.)

topic.sub: 夫の怒りっぽさと無視についての悩み
